ayahs.3: Jo jhilli ke khule hue waraq mein hai.
ayahs.7: Beshak aap ke Rabb ka azaab ho kar rehne wala hai.
ayahs.11: Us din jhutlane walon ko (poori) kharabi hai.
ayahs.12: Jo apni behooda-goi mein uchhal-kood kar rahe hain.
ayahs.13: Jis din woh dhakke de de kar aatish-e-Jahannam ki taraf laaye jaayenge.
ayahs.14: Yehi woh aatish-e-Dozakh hai jise tum jhoot batlaate the.
ayahs.15: (Ab batao) kya yeh jaadu hai? Ya tum dekhte hi nahin ho.
ayahs.16: Jaao dozakh mein ab tumhara sabr karna aur na karna tumhare liye yaksaan hai tumhein faqat tumhare kiye ka badla diya jaayega.
ayahs.17: Yaqeenan parhezgar log jannaton mein aur ne'maton mein hain.
ayahs.18: Jo unhein un ke Rabb ne de rakhi hain is par khush khush hain, aur un ke Parwardigar ne unhein jahannam ke azaab se bhi bacha liya hai.
ayahs.19: Tum maze se khaate peete raho un aamaal ke badle jo tum karte the.
ayahs.20: Barabar bichhe hue shaandaar takhton par takiye lagaaye hue. Aur hum ne un ke nikah badi badi aankhon wali (hooron) se kar diye hain.
ayahs.21: Aur jo log imaan laaye aur un ki aulaad ne bhi imaan mein un ki pairwi ki hum un ki aulaad ko un tak pahuncha denge aur un ke amal se hum kuchh kam na karenge, har shakhs apne apne aamaal ka girvi hai.
ayahs.22: Hum un ke liye mewe aur marghoob gosht ki rel-pel kar denge.
ayahs.23: (khush-tabee ke saath) ek doosre se jaam (sharab) ki chheena-jhapti karenge jis sharab ke suroor mein to behooda-goi hogi na gunaah.
ayahs.24: Aur un ke ird-gird un ke nau-umar ghulam chal phir rahe honge, goya ke woh moti the jo dhake rakhe the.
ayahs.25: Aur aapas mein ek doosre ki taraf mutawajjeh ho kar sawaal karenge.
ayahs.26: Kahenge ke is se pehle hum apne ghar walon ke darmiyan bahut dara karte the.
ayahs.27: Pas Allah Taala ne hum par bada ehsaan kiya aur hamein tez-o-tund garam hawaon ke azaab se bacha liya.
ayahs.28: Hum is se pehle hi is ki ibaadat kiya karte the, beshak woh mohsin aur Meharban hai.
ayahs.29: To aap samjhaate rahen kyunke aap apne Rabb ke fazl se na to kaahin hain na deewana.
ayahs.30: Kya kaafir yun kehte hain ke yeh shayar hai hum is par zamane ke hawadis (yaani maut) ka intezar kar rahe hain.
ayahs.31: Keh dijiye! Tum muntazir raho main bhi tumhare saath intezar karne walon mein hoon.
ayahs.32: Kya un ki aqlein unhein yehi sikhati hain? Ya yeh log hi sarkash hain.
ayahs.33: Kya yeh kehte hain ke is Nabi ne (Quran) khud ghad liya hai, waqia yeh hai ke woh imaan nahin laate.
ayahs.34: Achchha agar yeh sachche hain to bhala is jaisi ek (hi) baat yeh (bhi) to le aayen.
ayahs.35: Kya yeh baghair kisi (paida karne wale) ke khud-bakhud paida ho gaye hain? Ya yeh khud paida karne wale hain?
ayahs.36: Kya unhon ne hi aasmanon aur zameen ko paida kiya hai? Balke yeh yaqeen na karne wale log hain.
ayahs.37: Ya kya un ke paas tere Rabb ke khazane hain? Ya (un khazanon ke) yeh darogha hain.
ayahs.38: Ya kya un ke paas koi seedhi hai jis par chadh kar sunte hain? (Agar aisa hai) to un ka sunne wala koi roshan daleel pesh kare.
ayahs.39: Kya Allah ki to sab ladkiyan hain aur tumhare haan ladke hain?
ayahs.40: Kya tu un se koi ujrat talab karta hai ke yeh is ke taawaan se bojhal ho rahe hain.
ayahs.41: Kya un ke paas ilm-e-ghaib hai jise yeh likh lete hain?
ayahs.42: Kya yeh log koi fareb karna chahte hain? To yaqeen kar len ke fareb-khurda kaafir hi hain.
ayahs.43: Kya Allah ke siwa un ka koi mabood hai? (Hargiz nahin) Allah Taala un ke shirk se paak hai.
ayahs.44: Agar yeh log aasman ke kisi tukde ko girta hua dekh len tab bhi keh den ke yeh teh-ba-teh baadal hai.
ayahs.45: To unhein chhod de yahan tak ke unhein us din se saabqa pade jis mein yeh be-hosh kar diye jaayenge.
ayahs.46: Jis din unhein un ka makar kuchh kaam na dega aur na woh madad kiye jaayenge.
ayahs.47: Beshak zaalimon ke liye is ke alawa aur azaab bhi hain. Lekin un logon mein se aksar be-ilm hain.
ayahs.48: To apne Rabb ke hukm ke intezar mein sabr se kaam le, beshak tu hamari aankhon ke saamne hai. Subah ko jab tu uthe apne Rabb ki paaki aur hamd bayaan kar.
ayahs.49: Aur raat ko bhi is ki tasbeeh padh aur sitaron ke doobte waqt bhi.
